scope: M01 authorized native visual/input checks and menu-layout repair; not complete M01 qualification
method: computer-use skill, @oai/sky native window input and screenshots; screenshots inspected through the tool and identified by returned IDs

primary_display.outcome: PASSED_NATIVE for observed settled layering, clipping, docking, pointer capture, zoom and maximize/restore

secondary_display.outcome: Mixed-DPI transition smoke and visible alignment pass; full 30-input sequence not completed before timer ended

menu_regression.before: Sticky in-flow menu margins displaced preview DOM frames without republishing geometry; GPU images stayed at prior positions.
menu_regression.repair: Use an absolutely positioned overlay with explicit rem offsets, and include menu visibility in the geometry publication effect.
menu_regression.after: Native menu covers preview pixels without moving frames; layout/rendered revisions advance at baseline and fractional zoom.

hidden_previews.outcome: Preview pixels cleared in settled capture; foreground native output still displayed blue/yellow after >60 seconds and submission counters advanced. Unique frame cadence/latency is not inferred.

automation_recoveries: Refreshed screenshot geometry after switching windows when element input reported geometry unavailable.
A coordinate click into the WebView native select popup was rejected as a different target window; refreshed and used keyboard navigation.
A title-bar restore attempt showed no transition; a fresh screenshot coordinate click restored the window.
An oversized monitor drag was rejected before execution; subsequent bounded title-bar drags crossed the existing monitor boundary.

interactive_capture.scope: interactive native UI qualification; not fixed-workload performance

exclusions: source/observer GPU usage and per-texture residency
COM release does not prove driver allocation retirement

unqualified: texture residency, displayed cadence and latency
hardware device removal and sustained retirement

open: Full secondary-display gesture sequence; 150%/200% OS scaling and negative origins
Quantitative physical-pixel alignment and input-to-visible latency; immediate captures showed transitional frames
Minimized/busy/disconnected editor independence and per-output displayed cadence/frame age
NVIDIA resource-retirement accumulation identified by the separate 100-cycle capture
Complete three-sample Q01/Q02 series, exact texture/copy accounting, genuine device removal/reset
